// PROBE — compliant: the severity word rendered as caveated text inside its own card, nothing else.
import { describeSeverity } from "@/lib/gaps/severity-display"
export function Card({ gap, t }: { gap: { severity: string; title: string }; t: (k: string) => string }) {
    const described = describeSeverity(gap.severity)
    return (
        <article className="pw-card">
            <h3>{gap.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">{t(described.labelKey)} · {t(described.caveatKey)}</p>
        </article>
    )
}
